questions.question: Identify the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Timid
questions.questionHtml:
Identify the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
Timid
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Daring. 

The meaning of the word 'Timid' is showing a lack of courage or confidence; easily frightened. 

The meaning of the word 'Daring' is adventurous or audaciously bold. 

The relation between them is that they are opposites; 'Timid' indicates fearfulness while 'Daring' indicates bravery.

The phrase "since I was born" is correct because "was born" refers to a past event, aligning with the present perfect continuous tense "have been living."

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A. More children go to school than at any time in the past. But more children today are out of school than any time in the past. B. But it is not enough to blame the high birth rate for this state of affairs. C. Indeed, it can be reasonably argued that continued mass illiteracy is not the result but the cause of the high birth rate. D. There are more literate people in India today than ever before. But there are also more illiterates than ever before.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.
A. More children go to school than at any time in the past. But more children today are out of school than any time in the past.
B. But it is not enough to blame the high birth rate for this state of affairs.
C. Indeed, it can be reasonably argued that continued mass illiteracy is not the result but the cause of the high birth rate.
D. There are more literate people in India today than ever before. But there are also more illiterates than ever before.
questions.solution: The correct answer is: DABC. The paragraph begins with sentence (D), which presents a paradox regarding literacy in India (more literates but also more illiterates). Sentence (A) follows this pattern by presenting a similar paradox regarding school attendance. Sentence (B) introduces a common explanation (high birth rate) for these statistics but suggests it is insufficient. Finally, sentence (C) provides a counter-argument, suggesting that mass illiteracy is actually the cause of the high birth rate, completing the logical progression.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the bold word in the following sentence. He tried to alleviate the sufferings of his neighbours.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bold word in the following sentence.
He tried to alleviate the sufferings of his neighbours.
questions.solution: The correct answer is: Relieve. The word "alleviate" means to make suffering or a problem less severe. The meanings of the other words are: Swell: To increase in size or volume; Add: To join or increase the amount; Intensify: To make more intense or severe.

questions.solution:

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice. The contract was grabbed by the biggest telecom company in India.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.
The contract was grabbed by the biggest telecom company in India.

options.text: The biggest telecom company in India grabbed the contract.
options.html: The biggest telecom company in India grabbed the contract.

options.text: The biggest telecom company in India grabs the contract.
options.html: The biggest telecom company in India grabs the contract.

options.text: The biggest telecom company in India will grab the contract.
options.html: The biggest telecom company in India will grab the contract.

options.text: The biggest telecom company in India has grabbed the contract.
options.html: The biggest telecom company in India has grabbed the contract.

questions.solution: The correct answer is: The biggest telecom company in India grabbed the contract. The given sentence is in Passive voice (Past Indefinite tense: Object + was/were + V3 + by + Subject). To convert it into Active voice, we use the structure: Subject + V2 + Object. Thus, "The biggest telecom company in India" (Subject) + "grabbed" (V2) + "the contract" (Object).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank. I'm ___________ about whether to accept the job offer or continue freelancing. Both options have their advantages.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

I'm ___________ about whether to accept the job offer or continue freelancing. Both options have their advantages.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: on the fence. 

Meaning: To be undecided or unsure about something. 

Usage explanation: In the sentence, "I'm on the fence about whether to accept the job offer or continue freelancing," it means the person is unsure and cannot decide between the two options.
